notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.3
notes.notes:
Changes

 Increased probability stat on 'Cinders' Offering.
 Tweaked explosion damage stat on 'Explosive Cinders' Offering.

Fixes

 Fixed 'Cinders' collision trigger.
 Fixed 'Cinders' applying incorrect damage.
 Fixed 'Total projectiles deflected' not being added to total stats.
 Fixed 'Void Fountain purchases' not being added to stats.
 Fixed 'Total Offerings collected' sometimes not being added to stats.
 Reduced the elevator travel time at the end of Tomb of the Sacrilegious to prevent player from bonking their head in the ceiling bounds.
 Disabled 'Floor is lava' in Scoria Ruins.
 Disabled 'Floor is lava' and 'Tight Deadline' in the NG+ starting room.
 Fixed 'Tight Deadline' not resetting upon death.
 Fixed projectiles not colliding with the big pillars in Tomb of the Sacrilegious.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.2
notes.notes:
Changes

 The final boss now takes 50% reduced damage during the phase transition.
 Updated the exit game prompt in the pause menu to clarify that only meta progression will be saved.

Fixes

 Fixed the tutorial Offering not disabling the controller cursor when closing the menu, causing the controller input to not work properly.
 Fixed FOV not resetting after performing a Void Dash with controller.
 Fixed chest in The Shadowed City not spawning enemies.
 Fixed a bug that caused Offering orbs to not be destroyed when pressing escape as the menu is being closed.
 Fixed a secret room in Sacred Grove unloading unintentionally.
 Fixed 'Void Laser' Offering on Essence Disruptor not being cancelled if the Ultimate version of the gun is being destroyed.
 Fixed rare case of the Petrified Tombwarden being moved outside the arena.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.1
notes.notes:
Changes
Final boss
Damage

 Phase 1 sword: 10 -> 8
 Phase 2 sword: 20 -> 15
 Laser projectile: 25 -> 20
 Arc projectile: 15 -> 10

Health

 Phase 1: 10000 -> 8500
 Phase 2: 10000 -> 7500

Petrified Tombwarden

 Added eyelids to the laser eye.
 Added new laser pattern during its final phase.

Other

 Exiting the entrance cave in The Shadowed City now sets the players last ground location right outside the one-way barrier.

Fixes

 Fixed chests reappearing in The Shadowed City.
 Fixed door not opening if the Essence Flask item is already picked up.
 Fixed Petrified Tombwarden sometimes not dying after the laser eye is destroyed. (surely fixed this time)
 Fixed 'Dead Man's Passage' achievement not unlocking.
 Fixed 'Forging' achievement not unlocking.
 Fixed projectiles not colliding various with walls, rocks and other obstacles in The Shadowed City.
 Tweaked teleport box in The Shadowed City to prevent player from getting trapped underneath.

notes.title: Voidborn 1.0 Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Note: The release date has been pushed from April 4th to April 7th

I am excited to announce that after 18 months of Early Access, Voidborn will finally be launching into 1.0 on April 7th!

This update will complete the full run of the game with the final area, along with many other additions, changes, and improvements throughout the entire game.

1.0 Announcement Trailer
[previewyoutube=bvEKo4FBegI;full][/previewyoutube]

Prepare yourself to ascend The Black Castle
The final area of the game, atop which the final demigod awaits you...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42678423/495979859eb74557850bda741cb731e67985d89d.png

In preparation for 1.0 release

Launch discount
1.0 will launch with a 20% discount. If you planned to pick up the game, I would advice to hold off until the release.

Pricing changes
After the launch sale is over, you can expect Voidborn to increase in price by around 15% depending on your currency. These pricing changes will also include new prices for the regions Latin America and Middle East / North Africa.

Demo
After the update the demo will no longer be available to download from Steam. But if you already have it installed you can still continue to play it as it is DRM-free, as is the full game!


Wishlist Voidborn to get notified on release! I hope to see you all there :)

notes.title: VOIDBORN DEMO UPDATE 1
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=nTUwD6NjS4E;full][/previewyoutube]
What's new?

 Three new power-ups, two of which are alternative fire modes for the rifle and shotgun, and one Void Dash power-up.
 Improved levels with much higher detail and better lighting.
 Reworked "Big Orange Ball" boss battle, now known as "Left Eye of the Crimson Void".
 Boss levels now have a small peaceful room before the battle with a Void Fountain and a health potion, restoring up to 25 health.
 Reworked dash system, you can now properly dash on inclined surfaces.
 Added directional sliding, you can now slide in all 8 movement directions.
 Sliding now takes the players movement velocity and kinetic energy into account.
 Improved visual clarity. Chasing enemies now have a different color from casters, dead enemies stop glowing, fireballs have a slighlty different color making them more distinguishable from lava and torches.
 Added custom key binds in settings.
 Added weapon swapping with scroll wheel (can be disabled in settings).
 Added cooldown displays on the HUD for abilities.
 Made it more clear when you picked up Essence.
 Hitting the fireball with the revolver now creates a more powerful explosion.

Other noteworthy fixes and improvements

 Improved performance.
 Improved wall-jumping/sliding accuracy.
 Fixed certain enemy attacks and particle effects being tied to the framerate.
 Nerfed Decay Demon's laser attack and overall damage.
 Decreased enemy spawns in certain levels.
 Decreased costs of Void Fountain upgrades.
 Increased pick up range of Essence.
 Increased melee damage.
 Bosses take increased damage from explosions and lightning attacks.
 Falling off the bridge in Bloodrain Valley now teleports you back.
 Slightly decreased the revolvers rate of fire.
 Increased spawn rate of blue torch pillars.
 Increased Void Dash impact range.
